output.headline: November 2, 2026: Regional Class A — Joliet ran alone, spending $110.90 for 2 leads at $55.45 each from 6,015 impressions at a 1.2% click rate.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running on November 2, 2026, with $110.90 spent, 6,015 impressions, 70 clicks, and 2 leads at a cost per lead of $55.45.
November 2026 has 29 days left; $198.00 has been spent on Meta so far this month.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) is mature: 33 were contacted, 17 converted, 10 applied, 4 hired, and 8 lost after conversion. None were closed as not qualified and none were closed before applying.
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) is mature: 36 were contacted, 20 converted, 12 applied, 5 hired, and 9 lost after conversion. None were closed as not qualified and none were closed before applying.
